newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Zimbabwe's Mugabe invites Cypriot investors.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe's Mugabe invites Cypriot investors.

text.p: Zimbabwe's President Robert Mugabe on Tuesday extended an open invitation to Cypriot businessmen to invest in his country.

"We believe that the competitive investment package that we have put together in Zimbabwe constitutes an irresistibly attractive climate for the Cypriot investor," said Mugabe, addressing a special session of the Cypriot parliament.
In the past six years Zimbabwe has embarked on broad-based economic reforms aimed at market-driven growth and sustainable development, Mugabe said.
The Zimbabwean president is on a three-day official visit to the eastern Mediterranean island, a Commonwealth partner and former British colony until independence in 1960.
Heading a 15-member delegation and accompanied by his wife Grace, Mugabe leaves Cyprus for Rome on Wednesday after a brief tour of the western coastal resort of Paphos.
